text:
lina_sales: Heads-up: Prospero kickoff 3/24. They want to replace CompetitorX with Redwood. Primary asks: identical calling surface, no user-visible output drift, and billing reconciliation.

noah_solutions: Do they expect identical headers and status codes? CompetitorX returns 202 for async, we return 200-stream. Need to map.

jia_engineering: Technical quick note: CompetitorX prepends a 6-byte session-hash to prompts for replay detection. We'll strip that in shim and preserve token accounting. Plan: adapter layer that normalizes request/response and translates session handshake to our API key model.

maria_se: Caching: they rely on hot server-side prefix cache keyed by conversation_id. Our cache keys are by (user_id, prefix_hash, model_family). We'll provide a mapping table and an option to enable "compat-mode" keys for the shim.

noah_solutions: Pricing: Prospero wants a clear example: if CompetitorX rounds up to next token vs our exact token billing, show month1 estimate. I'll prepare a spreadsheet.

dan_security: From security: they require BYOK and SAML SSO + audit log access. We have BYOK via customer KMS and can export audit logs via secure S3 with retention policy. Request: staging CIDR ranges and sample DPA clauses.

tyler_pm: Timeline proposal: 10 working days POC. Day1-3: shim deploy and vault/KMS handoff; Day4-7: parity tests (stopwords, streaming chunking, function-call shapes); Day8-10: perf/billing validation and runbook handoff.

lina_sales: we'll ask Prospero for 12 representative prompts and the burst load profile. Also ask which CompetitorX SDK features they depend on (streaming deltas vs evented chunks).

jia_engineering: Smoke test for shim (example):

```
curl -X POST https://prospero-shim.redwood.internal/v1/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer SHIM_KEY" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: quarterly results"}] }'
```

jia_engineering: Note: include header X-Orig-Request-Id to map billing back to original CompetitorX request_id.

maria_se: For parity cases: include edge tests for temperature=0 with system prompts, tokenizer boundary truncation, and streaming split on UTF-8 multi-byte characters.

noah_solutions: I'll add an example billing reconciliation: if CompetitorX charges 1.05x on average due to token rounding, propose 30% migration credit in month1 to offset.

dan_security: Also need answers for pen-test windows and SOC2 evidence. Prospero's procurement will request a copy of our latest SOC2 report and a contact for pen-test scheduling.

tyler_pm: I'll own the parity checklist doc and the deliverable tracker. Linting: ensure we add acceptance criteria for "no-significant-drift" defined as <5% difference in task-specific eval suite.

lina_sales: Great. Can we do a readiness sync tomorrow 9am? @jia_engineering @dan_security @noah_solutions

noah_solutions: 9am ok. I'll bring the cost sample and adapter architecture diagram.

jia_engineering: 9am, I'll have the shim repo link and quickstart script.

dan_security: I'll post the vendor questionnaire redlines before the meeting.

deploy_bot: deploy queued: prospero-shim-staging v0.0.1 -> us-east-1 at 2026-03-20T09:05Z (https://deploys.redwood/company/6001) :white_check_mark:

lina_sales: Thanks team. I'll draft the outreach email to Prospero and attach the POC timeline + parity template.
